description: Declared intentional differences between the Bee module API (Bee.* facade) and the GenServer message protocol ({verb, args}). The parity harness (test/parity_harness_test.exs) reads this list and allows these differences. Any difference NOT listed here is a parity bug.

exceptions.name: validation_error_surface
exceptions.description: Structural/type validation errors (invalid order_by, limit, offset, include) raise ArgumentError in the module API caller process but return {:error, reason} at the GenServer message boundary. This is by design (AD-25, Story 1.1) so a bad option arriving by message never raises inside handle_call and kills the single writer with every queued command behind it.
